parent_and_effective_support.rule: derive support from the registered claim tier, estimand, independent acquisition hierarchy, dependence or ICC, effect size, sensitivity, and power surface
forbidden: promoting nested samples, modalities, pixels, time points, or null children to independent parents
awarding full support when parent count or hierarchy is unknown

joint_null_aggregation.rule: one aggregate null replicate selects one registered null child per independent parent and applies the same aggregate statistic as the observed data
joint_null_aggregation.forbidden: flattening parent-local null children into a pseudo-population

scale_relative_metrology.rule: preserve unit provenance and evaluate uncertainty using relative robust noise and registered scale perturbations

boundary_and_tie_diagnostics.firewall: an elbow is not T_e or winner_N and has no theory or repair authority

typed_scout_eligibility.rule: require a registered typed geometry handler, coordinate and unit contract, masks, projection law, nesting map, and applicable null before scoring

repeat_policy.rule: repeats require prospective authorization and a declared role; failed or ambiguous outcomes are preserved
forbidden: counting a verifier as a second scored assay

structured_fragility.rule: report graded effect sizes, uncertainty, and disagreements rather than one success Boolean

timing_non_authority.rule: wall-clock, CPU-jitter, latency, and throughput observations are operational telemetry only
